strategy: Mardu (W/B/R) meld midrange with a reanimator-lite subtheme
identity: All three Innistrad meld pairs (Brisela, Hanweir the Writhing Township, Chittering Host) built as pure upside on top of a removal-and-recursion Mardu midrange shell; Through the Breach cheats Griselbrand in early, and its own sacrifice clause sets up a permanent Edgar's Awakening reanimation later.

restrictions.max_total_rare_mythic_note: Relaxed from default 5 to 6, per explicit user approval, to fit the full meld package (3 pairs) plus both named keystones (Griselbrand, Through the Breach).
